representation.spatial_mask: nonzero input joint across XYZ/time; person-major then joint-major
representation.spatial_pool: masked mean of valid tokens; reject all-invalid windows

model.initialization: Xavier uniform Linear/Conv1d; bias zero; LayerNorm weight one; residual final conv zero

training.shuffle: torch.randperm(all windows, generator seed=seed+epoch), shared across four candidates
training.loss: dense frame CE; weighted sum divided by sum of target-class weights in each minibatch
training.sqrt_weight_counts: unique covered training frames only, derived four-class labels
training.sqrt_weight_normalization: inverse sqrt count divided by mean across four classes; all classes required

evaluation.timeline: float64 accumulation of raw window logits; mean then float32; softmax after overlap mean
evaluation.coverage: only frames covered by clean windows; uncovered frames excluded and counted
evaluation.ties: earlier epoch then declared candidate order; no historical target matching
evaluation.fall_vs_unstable: coarse labels 9 vs 10, positive=10, score=4-class softmax p(fall)
evaluation.fall_vs_lie: derived labels 1/2/3, positive=1, score=softmax over logits columns 1:4 p(fall)
evaluation.event_prediction: contiguous argmax-fall runs on covered frames; no smoothing/minimum/merge gap
evaluation.event_truth: contiguous coarse-fall=10 runs on covered frames
evaluation.event_match: per sequence greedy descending temporal IoU >=0.1; tie by earlier prediction then truth; one-to-one
evaluation.test_ood: selected candidate/epoch only after all train/val selection; no tuning

execution.resume: same code/config; cache at flushed batches; training at completed epoch checkpoints

known_historical_contract: validation macro-F1 then unstable AUPRC then lying F1
